description: Nature research figure guide: 89mm single column, Arial/Helvetica 5-7pt, colour-blind-safe palette, vector formats with editable text.
requirements_notes: Printed figure widths: 89 mm (single column) or 183 mm (double column); maximum height 170 mm.
Use standard fonts (e.g. Arial or Helvetica). Maximum text size: 7pt. Minimum text size: 5pt.
For figures to be accepted all text needs to be legible and editable. Do not outline text. Embed fonts (True Type 2 or 42).
Main figures: vector files with editable layers; .ai/.eps/.pdf preferred, .svg acceptable (plain svg).
Colour palette values published in the guide are the Okabe-Ito colour-blind-safe set (see colors.palette).

colors.note: Okabe-Ito palette as listed by the Nature research figure guide (colour-blind safe)
